baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated object series after 'We gave the Children of Israel': book, judgment, prophethood, provision, good things, and preference.
baseline_models.mechanism: The giving equips an inherited corporate body. The book gathers and fixes, judgment checks disorder and adjudicates, and prophethood mediates report from God; the conjunctions layer capacities rather than merely accumulate honors.

activation_trace.role: The giving sense makes the series a conferred equipment package.
Lineage and derivation make the recipient an intergenerational corporate body.
Joining separate pieces supplies the book's collecting and binding function.
Binding determination makes the book norm-producing, not merely a document.
Corrective restraint supplies the order-preserving function of judgment.
Adjudication supplies the public decision function of the endowed order.
The divine envoy sense supplies mediated guidance within the institutional package.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of prestigious gifts bestowed on an ethnic lineage.
changed_reading.after: The ayah constitutes a lineage with mutually reinforcing textual, corrective, judicial, and prophetic capacities.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The progression from 'provided them' through 'good things' to 'favored them over the worlds.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The second half moves from an apportioned benefit to wholesome usability, then to surplus and comparative degree. Preference can therefore be read as the culmination of a distributional sequence rather than as an isolated epithet.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned share supplies the distributive starting point.
Wholesomeness qualifies the share by its beneficial and permissible use.
Excess beyond need turns provision into surplus capacity.
Comparative degree converts surplus capacity into relative distinction.

changed_reading.before: Material provision and superior rank are two unrelated favors in the list.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome apportioned provision develops into surplus capacity and then into comparative distinction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The book, prophethood, preference, and the final word rooted in ع ل م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The registration capacity of the book, the reporting capacity of prophethood, and the marking capacity of ع ل م allow preference to carry public legibility: the lineage is entered, instructed, and made conspicuous among collectivities. This coexists with the ordinary comparative sense of 'worlds.'

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register supplies corporate inscription and membership.
A consequential report supplies public communication rather than private possession.
Comparative degree supplies selection among other collectivities.
A distinguishing mark makes the selected group publicly legible and exemplary.

changed_reading.before: Preference is private possession of prestige over external populations.
changed_reading.after: Preference may also make the recipients an inscribed, communicative, and conspicuous case among the worlds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents the book as delivered from God and pairs its source with irresistible authority and wisdom. The focus giving is thus downstream transmission: Israel's textual and judicial capacities derive from a source whose power can deliver and whose wisdom orders.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination anchors the focus book as an ordering instrument.
Right-knowing wisdom anchors judgment as more than coercive rule.
Directed delivery makes the book arrive from a higher source into the recipient setting.
The same binding book function links the opening delivery to the focus grant.
Prevailing authority supplies the effective power behind delivery.
Accurate wisdom supplies the source-quality later delegated as judgment.

structural_cues: The first rooted statement after the opening letters is a book-delivery clause with an explicit divine source.
The opening divine title and the focus gift repeat the ح ك م root in source and recipient positions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, divine source, power, and wisdom; I infer a backward arrow from those source qualities to the focus package as delegated order. A live alternative is that 45:2 establishes authorship only, without specifying the social function of the later gifts.

changed_reading.before: Israel receives a self-contained institutional package.
changed_reading.after: Israel receives a transmitted order whose textual and judicial authority remains derivative of the delivering divine source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain is named as provision, revives dead earth, and is joined to circulating winds; later the sea is made serviceable so vessels run, bounty is sought, and gratitude becomes the intended response. The focus provision-goodness-preference series expands into a circuit of delivery, reception, movement, productive seeking, surplus, and acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Apportioned benefit anchors the focus provision as an input to the circuit.
Beneficial wholesomeness marks the quality of what the circuit delivers.
Surplus anchors the output that exceeds bare subsistence.
Rain-as-provision materializes the focus allotment as a descending life input.
Earth's revival by rain supplies the receiving and productive stage.
Loss of life establishes the depleted state that provision reverses.
Turning from state to state supplies circulation and transformation.
Moving air supplies the medium through which the ecological circuit is distributed.
Making the sea serviceable converts environment into usable opportunity.
Flowing movement carries recipients through that opportunity.
Sought surplus links productive movement back to the focus preference root.
Recognition of benefit supplies the circuit's intended human return.

structural_cues: In 45:5 the grammar explicitly makes descending provision the means by which dead earth is revived.
In 45:12 the purpose chain runs from sea serviceability to vessel movement, seeking bounty, and possible gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both causal chains; I infer that the compact focus list recapitulates their input-to-surplus logic and that preference includes enabled productivity. Alternatively, the ecological and maritime scenes may exemplify universal favors without defining Israel's particular provision.

changed_reading.before: The good provisions are a static stock of privileged goods.
changed_reading.after: The provisions belong to a renewable life-support and work circuit whose surplus is sought through movement and answered by gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated knowing, visible signs, inner sight, guidance, and certainty activate the marking potential of the focus final root. Their reversal through sealing and covering prevents a simple equation of endowment with understanding. Preference can therefore make Israel a conspicuous epistemic case, exposed to recognition and failure, not merely a population ranked above others.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the possibility that the worlds phrase carries public visibility.
Acquired knowledge supplies an explicit epistemic activation of the focus root.
A visible sign makes knowledge answerable to what has been shown.
Inner sight supplies the receptive faculty by which public signs become insight.
Gentle direction toward the right path gives perception an orienting function.
Settled knowledge supplies the successful endpoint of epistemic reception.
Knowledge recurs in a scene where possession of it does not ensure right orientation.
A securing seal supplies blockage of the receptive channel.
Understanding and compliance identify what the sealed hearing fails to perform.
Inner sight repeats as a faculty placed under obstruction.
An overlying cover supplies the mechanism by which visibility fails to become perception.

structural_cues: The ع ل م root alternates between the focus worlds noun and active knowledge or non-knowledge across the surrounding ayat.
45:20 clusters insight, guidance, and certainty; 45:23 reverses the cluster through sealed hearing and covered sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root recurrence and opposed perception clusters; I infer that being preferred also makes the recipient a marked test case whose visibility raises epistemic responsibility. The live alternative is that 'worlds' is fully lexicalized here and carries no active knowing or marking resonance.

changed_reading.before: They are superior to external populations in an unqualified comparison.
changed_reading.after: They are also made conspicuous among the worlds as a knowledge-bearing case in which exposure can yield either insight or blocked reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus collective endowment is preceded by action returning to each self and followed by a rejection of morally flattening judgment, then repayment of every self by what it earned. Historical preference therefore does not operate as collective immunity; judgment differentiates persons by response and action.

activation_trace.role: Comparative rank anchors the collective distinction that must be delimited.
Adjudication anchors the capacity whose later use tests how distinction is judged.
Intentional action supplies the unit by which benefit or harm is generated.
The individual self localizes the consequence of action.
Return supplies the movement from present action toward final reckoning.
Supposition supplies the mistaken premise that unlike moral groups can be treated alike.
Equalization supplies the false judicial result explicitly challenged.
Judgment recurs as the act condemned when it erases relevant differences.
Reciprocal recompense supplies the correct differentiating rule.
Every self makes the scope of recompense individual rather than hereditary.
Acquired outcome ties judgment to what each self actually produces.
Withholding a right supplies the harm explicitly negated by just recompense.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding ayah assigns good and evil action to the acting self before announcing the collective gifts.
The later rhetorical question rejects equal life and death outcomes, and 45:22 repeats 'every self.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the individual-collective-individual sequence and the explicit judgment contrast; I infer that these clauses limit what preference can entail. Alternatively, the focus may report a past collective distinction without itself addressing later individual standing.

changed_reading.before: Preference over the worlds sounds like a collective verdict transferable to every descendant.
changed_reading.after: Preference names a historical collective endowment, while each recipient remains non-exempt and is differentiated by action under judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats giving, specifies manifest clarifications, then sequences divergence after knowledge through aggressive overreaching and toward divine adjudication. The focus gifts are not a stable endpoint: the very clarity they install can become the substrate of internal rivalry.

activation_trace.role: Conferred giving anchors the focus package that is repeated in the next ayah.
Adjudication anchors the gift that later returns as the resolution of dispute.
Repeated giving extends the focus inventory with manifest clarifications.
Manifest appearance supplies the clarity from which the later conflict departs.
Taking different paths supplies the internal fragmentation of one endowed group.
Known disclosure makes the disagreement post-knowledge rather than innocent uncertainty.
Crossing the limit through aggression supplies the social motor of divergence.
A cutting judgment supplies the endpoint to which unresolved rivalry is deferred.

structural_cues: 45:17 directly resumes the plural recipients and the giving verb of the focus ayah.
Its temporal syntax orders clarity, knowledge, aggressive rivalry, disagreement, and eventual judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence but not a universal causal law; I infer that endowed clarity becomes contestable capital when rivalry supplies the arrow into divergence. A live alternative is that rivalry merely accompanies, rather than exploits, the received knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The gifts secure a coherent and durable privileged order.
changed_reading.after: The gifts create clear capacities whose possession can intensify internal rivalry and therefore increase exposure to judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus judgment can function as a bridle, and prophethood as a clear road; 45:18 then supplies an exposed water-access path, repeated tracking, and the opposed pull of self-inclination without knowledge. Together they activate a movement system in which revelation opens a route and judgment restrains deviation.

activation_trace.role: A bridle-like check gives judgment a steering and restraint function.
A clear road gives prophethood a route-making function.
An exposed access point to water supplies a concrete path toward sustaining order.
Tracing an effect step by step supplies the movement required to remain on the route.
The self's inclination supplies the competing force that pulls movement off course.
Knowledge supplies the orientation absent from the rival path.

structural_cues: 45:18 places the addressee 'upon' a sharia and opposes two occurrences of following.
The commanded route is singular, while the rival object is plural inclinations attributed to those who do not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road, bridle, access, tracking, inclination, and knowledge images; I assemble them into a steering system. The conventional legal-guidance reading remains live, while the transport and water mechanics are exploratory material analogies rather than replacement glosses.

changed_reading.before: Book, judgment, and prophethood are three honorific possessions.
changed_reading.after: They can operate as a routed discipline: disclosure opens the way, judgment checks movement, and prophetic guidance keeps the community from following ungrounded inclination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every community is called to its book for recompense; the following book speaks with truth because deeds have been copied. This turns the focus book from a one-way prestige object into one side of a reciprocal archive: it gives norm and later addresses the community with an evidentiary record.

activation_trace.role: Registration anchors the focus book as a device that can enroll a collective.
Binding determination anchors its forward normative force.
A community as a gathered type supplies the corporate unit summoned to an account.
Calling by speech moves each community into the book's adjudicative encounter.
Its own register gives each community an enrolled evidentiary identity.
Recompense makes the archive operational rather than merely memorial.
An articulate indication lets the book function as evidence that addresses its readers.
Reality-matching truth constrains what the speaking record can assert.
Copying from one book to another supplies the record-production mechanism.
Intentional deeds supply the archive's content.

structural_cues: 45:28 repeats 'every community' and pairs each one with 'its book.'
45:29 immediately personifies the book as speaking and gives ongoing deed-copying as its evidentiary basis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scripture in the focus and communal or divine books in 45:28-29; I infer a reciprocal relation in which norm-giving and deed-recording answer each other. A live alternative keeps the focus scripture and the later deed ledger as distinct senses with no single archive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Possession of the book is a one-way badge of scriptural advantage.
changed_reading.after: The book also initiates an evidentiary relation: the endowed community receives a norm, is registered by deeds, and eventually hears a truthful record speak back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close assigns praise and lordship over the heavens, earth, and all worlds to God, then reserves greatness, prevailing power, and wisdom for Him. The focus preference is thereby nested inside universal divine ownership and judgment: it is delegated and historical, not a transfer of ultimate supremacy.

activation_trace.role: Comparative degree anchors Israel's real but relative rank.
The distinguishing field of worlds anchors the scope within which that rank is expressed.
Received wisdom anchors a quality that the closing verse returns to its divine source.
Praise as the opposite of blame assigns final evaluative credit to God.
Sovereign lordship encloses every named cosmic domain and all worlds.
The repeated worlds root closes the same comparative field opened in the focus.
Exclusive greatness prevents delegated preference from becoming absolute supremacy.
Prevailing power locates effective sovereignty in God.
Divine wisdom reclaims the source of the judgment earlier given to Israel.

structural_cues: The surah closes by repeating both the worlds noun from the focus and the wisdom root from its gift list.
The repeated 'Lord of' construction spans heavens, earth, and worlds before the final power-wisdom pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical return and universal lordship; I infer that the close limits the ontology of Israel's preference to a delegated distinction. Alternatively, the closing doxology may praise God without directly qualifying the historical comparison in 45:16.

changed_reading.before: Preference over the worlds can sound like an absolute and self-grounding supremacy.
changed_reading.after: The preference is a real but bounded distinction inside God's lordship over every world, with wisdom and greatness remaining finally His.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it synchronizes form-distant watercourse, bridle, and road branches across distinct focus words. It remains anchored in the focus giving, judgment, prophethood, and provision roots and is activated by the packet's rain, flow, and water-access sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material systems analogy, not as a lexical replacement for giving, judgment, or prophethood.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence ءاتينا, الحكم, النبوة, رزقناهم, and فضلناهم.

activation_trace.role: A cleared watercourse turns giving into the opening and directing of access.
A bridle supplies regulation of movement through the opened channel.
A clear road supplies directional continuity from source to destination.
Rain-as-provision supplies the life-bearing substance moved through the system.
Surplus supplies what remains after the routed system meets need.
Directed descent supplies movement from source toward a receiving field.
Revived earth demonstrates productive reception at the route's endpoint.
Flowing vessels make route traversal visible at a human scale.
Visible access to water joins guidance to entry into a sustaining flow.

changed_reading.before: God transfers a set of discrete objects and statuses to Israel.
changed_reading.after: The ayah may sketch a routed endowment system: access is opened, movement is regulated, guidance carries benefit, and provision yields surplus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads preference through surplus and gratuitous giving rather than primarily through rank. The focus فضل and رزق branches anchor it, while later seeking, gratitude, pardon, and good action provide a possible output path. The obligation arrow is reader-supplied, so downstream prose should say the surplus may invite or enable such conduct, not that the ayah explicitly commands redistribution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The movement from provision to good things and فضل in 45:16.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned benefit supplies the entrusted resource.
Excess beyond need supplies capacity that can overflow rather than terminate in possession.
A non-obligatory benefaction supplies an ethical pattern for using surplus gratuitously.
Sought benefaction presents فضل as an available good rather than only social superiority.
Acknowledgment of benefit supplies one response to received surplus.
Protective covering of fault supplies a gratuitous social response to opposition.
Intentional good action supplies a second possible outlet for endowed capacity.

changed_reading.before: Favor denotes a higher place possessed by the favored group.
changed_reading.after: Favor may also denote entrusted excess whose fitting outputs are acknowledgment, forbearance, and constructive action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a later challenge involving fathers press backward on the focus lineage title, even though the later speakers are not explicitly identified with Israel. It remains anchored in the focus children and registration branches and in the packet's recitation, proof, bringing, and fatherhood sequence. Downstream prose must frame it as intergenerational counterpressure on inherited status, not as an identification of the two groups.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'Children of Israel' as a lineage receiving an enrolled set of gifts.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and derivation anchor inherited corporate identity.
Enrollment anchors a status that descendants may treat as inherited membership.
Following recitation supplies the present disclosure to which descendants must respond.
Manifest clarity removes ancestry as a substitute for available evidence.
A prevailing proof supplies the argumentative standard the ancestral demand tries to set.
Demanded arrival turns the fathers into requested evidence rather than an automatically effective inheritance.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply the explicit ancestral pole against which sonship is tested.

changed_reading.before: 'Children of Israel' functions only as a genealogical identifier for recipients of past gifts.
changed_reading.after: The lineage title may also expose descendants to an intergenerational test: inherited enrollment cannot replace a present response to manifest disclosure.

strongest_changes: The gift list became a transmitted constitutional package whose textual and judicial authority remains derivative of its divine source.
Provision and preference became a life-support and work circuit moving from rain and revived earth through navigable opportunity to surplus and gratitude.
Collective preference lost any implication of immunity: received clarity can be converted into rivalry, while every self remains answerable for action.
The book became bidirectional, first giving norm and later speaking as a truthful deed record, while the closing lordship over all worlds bounded Israel's rank.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activation was the convergence of watercourse, bridle, road, rain, flow, and sharia branches into a contained routing analogy. A second unusual activation retained the marking and knowing resonance of ع ل م in 'worlds,' allowing preference to imply conspicuous epistemic responsibility without displacing the ordinary worlds reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus scripture and the later communal deed ledger may be functionally reciprocal yet remain distinct senses of book.
The marking and knowing resonance in the lexicalized worlds noun may be active, faint, or absent.
The hydraulic and steering model may reveal a real cross-ayah mechanism or only a productive material analogy.
The ethical movement from surplus to pardon and good action is enabled by context but not explicitly asserted as an obligation in the focus ayah.
